name: Max Miller
summary:
Max Leonard Miller (born November 13, 1988) is an American politician who is the U.S. representative for Ohio's 7th congressional district. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as a political appointee in the first Donald Trump administration.
In 2026, Miller's re-election campaign was embroiled in controversy after his ex-wife, Emily Moreno, accused him of domestic violence and of abusing their daughter.
